Build agent team.
Let it work safely.

Anchi lets agents work like colleagues. Create different roles, assign tasks, and bring them together as a team.

Set boundaries for each agent. Real credentials stay out of sandboxes. You authorize the writes that matter.

$ curl -fsSL https://anchi.elseward.xyz/install.sh | sh

Developer preview · macOS / Linux

01 / WORKFLOW

Build a team. Put it to work.

Create agents

Describe the teammate and define its role.

Form a team

Choose teammates and set who can delegate to whom.

Assign tasks

Give the team a goal and let it work together.

02 / BOUNDARY

Let agents work.Keep the keys.

Isolated tasks

Each task runs in its own cell inside a local VM.

Protected credentials

Trusted services use real credentials outside the sandbox.

Access and approvals

Set folder, connector, and network access. Approve high-risk writes.

[i]

Credential isolation is not data isolation. What an agent reads can still reach a cloud model. Security model ↗
